posts.dek: Sixteen players, four eras and one impossible roster. Shak builds an all time Starting Five, Bench Mob and Honorable Mentions, then gives every legend a transparent We Know the W rating.

sections.title: Built to play, not simply rank
paragraphs: This is not a one through sixteen résumé list. The Starting Five must fit, the Bench Mob must change a game, and the Honorable Mentions must show how deep thirty seasons of WNBA greatness really run.

sections.title: The W Score
paragraphs: Each player is graded on peak dominance, winning and playoff translation, two way impact, longevity, role portability and league imprint. The scale remains open because the league is still writing its history.
